remarks: Introducing the NEW Cardinal by Justin Gray Homes, a stunning walkout bungalow professionally designed by CM Interior Designs. Situated on a 36-pocket lot w/ a south-facing rear yard overlooking the ravine, this home offers 3,052 sqft of developed living space, fully finished walkout basement. The 1,690 sqft main floor features 10’ ceilings w/ VAULTED KITCHEN/DINING, hardwood flooring, a spacious great room, dining area & chef-inspired kitchen w/ large island & walk-through pantry. The private primary retreat includes a spa-inspired ensuite & walk-in closet. Den/bedrm w/ stained doors, main-floor laundry, large deck,impressive triple attached garage complete this level. The 1,362 sqft. lower level offers 8.9' ceilings, 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, gym, games area, recreation room, wet bar & ample storage! Finished in the sophisticated Cedar Peak interior palette w/200-amp service and exceptional attention to detail. Enjoy beautiful ravine views, nearby trails, parks & mins from all major amenities.
